item.text: {"cost_regression":false,"evidence":{"O1":{"citation":"Pass: The edit directly replaces “make it good” and makes completion observable: “derive concrete, observable completion criteria… inspect the artifact against each criterion, repair every identified gap, and finish only when the artifact passes that verification.”","status":"pass"},"O2":{"citation":"Pass: The artifact narrowly says, “Replace ‘make it good’ with,” and proposes no unrelated skill changes.","status":"pass"},"O3":{"citation":"Pass: The revision leads with the clear directive, “Do not stop at a subjective quality judgment,” followed by concrete verification actions.","status":"pass"},"O4":{"citation":"Pass: It says, “Then re-evaluate all three cases,” using “a fresh, context-free agent” for each and “separate judges” assessing the artifacts.","status":"pass"},"O5":{"citation":"Fail: It requests “each case’s before/after result” and “overall pass-rate movement,” but does not require repeated trials or per-case pass rates; each case is only blind-run once.","status":"fail"},"S1":{"citation":"Pass: The smell is absent; the replacement specifies observable criteria, artifact inspection, gap repair, and verification before finishing.","status":"pass"},"S2":{"citation":"Pass: The smell is absent; only the implicated phrase “make it good” is replaced.","status":"pass"},"S3":{"citation":"Pass: The smell is absent; “Do not stop at a subjective quality judgment” is a leading directive backed by specific actions rather than accumulated generic prose.","status":"pass"},"S4":{"citation":"Pass: The smell is absent because the artifact explicitly requires a “full three-case sweep,” including previously passing cases.","status":"pass"},"S5":{"citation":"Fail: Each case receives only one post-edit run, and the repeat condition applies only “If any case still fails—or a previously passing case regresses.” Thus one green sweep can be accepted without replication.","status":"fail"}},"passed":false,"rationale":"The proposed edit is precise, observable, and narrowly targeted, and it correctly reruns the entire suite with fresh runners and separate judges.
